---
title: "Prophet Model Implementation for Digital Payment Volume Forecasting with Holiday and Event Effects"
subtitle: "ATSA Group 2: Rohan Dedhia, Duncan D'lima, Sanaz Katpitia"
toc: false
---

We forecast daily UPI transaction volume with Prophet and test how much holidays and events improve the forecast.

::: {.callout-note}
NPCI publishes UPI data monthly only. The daily series here is **synthetic**, built from real NPCI monthly totals (Jan 2022 to Aug 2026) with holiday and event effects of known size.
:::

## Key results

| | |
|---|---|
| **2.45%** | Forecast error (MAPE) of Prophet with holidays and events |
| **5.54%** | Seasonal naive baseline |
| **4.96%** | SARIMAX with the same calendar information |
| **30%** | Lower error on holiday days after adding holidays |
| **6.2% vs 6.0%** | Estimated vs true payday effect |
